f.title: Report the quantity of product distributed under the biologics license, including to distributors, every 6 months
f.statement: The applicant must submit to CBER or CDER information about the quantity of the product distributed under the biologics license, including the quantity distributed to distributors. The interval between distribution reports must be 6 months.
f.clause: 21 CFR 600.81 Distribution reports, paragraph (a) Reporting requirements
f.applicability: Biological products distributed under a biologics license

f.title: Include bulk lot, fill lot, label lot, expiry, doses and release date in each distribution report

f.title: Report significant returns of a fill or label lot; financial and pricing data are not required
f.statement: If any significant amount of a fill lot/label lot is returned, the applicant must include this information in the distribution report. Disclosure of financial or pricing data is not required.

f.applicability: Biological products distributed under a biologics license

f.title: Submit distribution reports in an electronic format FDA can process, review and archive
f.statement: Except as provided in paragraph (b)(2), the distribution reports required under paragraph (a) must be submitted to FDA in an electronic format that FDA can process, review, and archive. FDA will issue guidance on how to provide the electronic submission.

f.title: Request a temporary waiver from electronic distribution reporting in writing under 600.90
f.statement: An applicant may request, in writing, a temporary waiver of the electronic format requirement in paragraph (b)(1). Waivers will be granted on a limited basis for good cause shown. Requests for waivers must be submitted in accordance with § 600.90.
f.applicability: Biological products distributed under a biologics license
